header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.arabic_text: اَرْحَامٌ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ، تَحَابُّوْا فِي اللهِ وَتَصَافُوْا، يَضَعُ اللهُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنَابِرَ مِنْ نُوْرٍ فَيُجْلِسُهُمْ عَلَيْهَا، فَيَجْعَلُ وُجُوْهَهُمْ نُوْرًا وَثِيَابَهُمْ نُوْرًا، يَفْزَعُ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا يَفْزَعُوْنَ، وَهُمْ اَوْلِيَاءُ اللهِ الَّذِيْنَ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَاهُمْ يَحْزَنُوْنَ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Rasulullah ﷺ said: “O people, listen! Understand! Know! Some righteous servants of Allah Ta'ala, who are neither Prophets nor Shuhada (martyrs), will be in a rank reserved for them alone; because of the special closeness and bond between Allah Ta'ala and them, the Prophets and the Shuhada will envy them.” A villager who lived very far from Madinah Munawwarah had come to Madinah at that time; (to draw the people's attention) he pointed his hand towards the Prophet ﷺ and asked, “O Rasulullah, describe to us the qualities of such people, who are neither Prophets nor Shuhada, who receive a rank reserved for them alone, and whom the Prophets and the Shuhada (martyrs) will envy because of the special closeness and bond between Allah Ta'ala and them.” At the question he asked, signs of joy began to appear on the face of Rasulullah ﷺ. “They are unknown people from among the general public, belonging to various tribes. There will be no close family relationship between them; they are those who have pure love for one another for the pleasure and approval of Allah Ta'ala. On the Day of Qiyamah, Allah Ta'ala will set up pulpits of light for them and seat them upon them.
